description: Only promote_candidate decisions with no risk flags, no review reasons, and an approved candidate review status may become active component rows.
Every candidate with a promotion decision should receive a database state transition: promoted, review, held, or rejected.
Every active component created from an approved candidate must have a component_version row with definition_source set to generated_factory and a deterministic definition hash.
Approved subcomponents are loaded only when their parent candidate is promoted, and each active subcomponent points to the promoted component id.
Generated candidate primitive types must be mapped to allowed component table types before active insertion.
Planning emits CSV and SQL only; actual psql execution is a separate operator or worker step.
